does: Covers a piece of meat in a layer of breadcrumbs over a sticky coat of mustard or beaten egg, which turns into a crisp crust when the piece is cooked.

intro.what: A thin layer of mustard or egg holds breadcrumbs around a piece of meat.
intro.why: The surface must support the crumbs without becoming slippery. This makes preparation as important as pressing the coating on.

how: Pat the pieces dry and season them.
Brush a thin, even layer of mustard or beaten egg over every side, so that the crumbs have something to hold to.
Tip the crumbs into a shallow dish. Press each piece into them, turn it, and press again.
Shake off the loose crumbs and lay the pieces on a rack, so that the coat sets before cooking.

cues.text: An even coat of crumbs on every side, with no bare patch.
The crumbs hold when the piece is picked up and do not rain off.

mistakes.mistake: Brushing on a thick layer of mustard, which slides off with the crumbs.
mistakes.fix: Brush on a thin, even layer.

mistakes.mistake: Coating wet meat, so that the crumbs go soggy and fall off.

quiz.question: What does the mustard or egg layer do here?
choices: Gives the breadcrumbs a surface to cling to.
Keeps the crumbs dry by preventing any adhesion.
Makes the crumbs slide freely over the meat.
quiz.because: The sticky film connects the dry crumbs to the prepared surface.

quiz.question: What comes before applying the binder?
choices: Pack crumbs onto the unprepared surface.
quiz.because: A dry starting surface helps the binder and crumbs adhere.

quiz.question: What should happen when the coated piece is lifted?
choices: The coating slides away in a wet sheet.
Most crumbs fall from bare patches.
quiz.because: Clinging crumbs show that the binder and coating have made contact.

quiz.question: A thick mustard layer slides off with the crumbs. What should change?
quiz.because: Excess binder becomes a slippery layer rather than an adhesive film.

comes_after.why: The meat is seasoned first, because the coat shuts the seasoning off once it is on.

variant_of.differs: Dredging dusts the piece with dry flour. Here a wet coat of mustard or egg goes on first and crumbs are pressed into it, to make a thick crisp crust.
